title: InsurVision - Intelligent Insurance Claim Analysis System
summary: IIT Hyderabad is developing InsurVision to analyze claims. Faster settlements and disaster recovery remain intended benefits, with implementation still in progress.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: IIT Hyderabad is developing InsurVision to analyze claims. Faster settlements and disaster recovery remain intended benefits, with implementation still in progress. Implementation plan in progress.
purpose: Help insurers analyze claims more quickly and consistently.

ratings.reason: Insurers are intended to process claims faster and more accurately.
Claimants are intended to receive faster support after losses; no actual claim outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
